subject: PenFirm access routing and SLA for evidence collection - scheduling and escalation plan
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@vanguardpentest.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + access checklist for Oct 18 pen test

Hi Marissa / team,

Nice to meet you all — Vanguard PenTest is scoped to run a 2-day engagement against the Redwood inference control plane starting Oct 18. Before the kickoff we need an operational checklist so our engineers can retrieve artifacts and validate fixes quickly. High-level asks: 

- Preferred evidence delivery mechanism (S3 presigned, NexusGRC connector, or secure SCP)
- Short-lived credentials or role assumption patterns (we prefer timeboxed STS presigned tokens)
- Access window(s) and IP allowlist requirements
- SLA for evidence response when we request a log or packet capture (we typically aim to triage within 24h; preferred is 8h)
- Primary escalation contacts and on-call rotation for after-hours

Can you confirm what we should expect and share any existing access matrix? I attached our discovery worksheet for reference.

Attachment: vanguard-discovery-worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — I can jump on a quick sync if helpful.

—Olivia
Olivia Grant
Program Manager, Vanguard PenTest
olivia.grant@vanguardpentest.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@vanguardpentest.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + access checklist for Oct 18 pen test

Hi Olivia — great to meet you and thanks for the worksheet. TL;DR: we can support an ephemeral evidence channel plus a NexusGRC connector. Below is our proposed pattern and a few open questions. I've attached our internal access matrix for the engagement.

Proposed evidence access pattern:
- Primary: timeboxed S3 pre-signed URLs generated from our evidence service (default retention 90 days)
- Secondary: NexusGRC connector (recommended for automated artifact ingestion) — integration requires a connector token and a one-time webhook registration
- For large forensic captures: secure SFTP behind a bastion; we can provide a jump host for the test window

Credentials & scope:
- We provide a temp service account with STS token that expires at the end of the agreed window (default 72 hours). Tokens are rotation-only and auditable in CloudTrail.
- If you need KMS-wrapped access for logs, we can provision a scoped decryption key via our KMS proxy.

SLA and escalation suggestions:
- Standard evidence request SLA: 24 business hours.
- We can support an elevated 8-hour SLA for requests marked P1 by Vanguard during the active test window if mutually agreed in advance.
- On-call: infra@redwoodinference.com (primary), ben_carter for escalation after 17:00 PT. For weekend bursts, please provide 24h notice.

Open questions for you:
1) Do you require access from a stable IP block (we can add an allowlist) or will you use ephemeral IPs?
2) Will Vanguard pull artifacts or do you prefer we push to a NexusGRC endpoint?
3) Any additional compliance checks the pen team requires (e.g., SOC2 artifact digesting, hash signing)

Attachment: vanguard-access-matrix.csv (csv)

I'll draft a brief mutual action plan and share a DocuSign link for the limited-scope engagement addendum. Want to hop on a 30-min call today at 2:30 PT?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships (Security)
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@vanguardpentest.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T12:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + access checklist for Oct 18 pen test

Folks — quick commercial/ops notes from my side: 

- Procurement: we prefer a scoped SOW addendum for this engagement (pricing + SSO/connector configuration). I'll send a one-page SOW and DocuSign for the MSA addendum after we lock the access model.
- SLA: agree to the 24 business hour baseline. For the 8-hour elevated SLA during active test windows we need a priced add-on; I'll propose that in SOW (we can be flexible on crediting if throughput or incidents exceed expected counts).
- Access runway: we need a defined access window (start/end datetime) and a rollback checklist (what we revoke at end-of-window). On revocation we also rotate any shared keys and invalidate pre-signed URLs.

Operational ask: can Vanguard provide a single point Slack/DM for real-time triage during the test? That speeds up verification.

I'll circulate the SOW draft by COB today.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-sow-template.docx (docx)

From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@vanguardpentest.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, NexusGRC Integrations <integrations@nexusgrc.io>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + access checklist for Oct 18 pen test

Thanks Ben / Marissa — appreciate the clarity. Quick answers and a couple of asks: 

- IPs: we operate from a set of stable egress ranges for scheduled engagements; I'll send our egress CIDR list in a follow-up. Allowlisting those addresses is easiest.
- Ingestion: NexusGRC pull is preferred for artifact indexing, but we can accept presigned pushes as fallback. We'll coordinate with integrations@nexusgrc.io to register the connector.
- KMS: we can accept KMS-wrapped artifacts if you provide a decrypt proxy.
- Evidence retention: 90 days default is fine. Please confirm auto-delete policy after retention window.
- Burst tests: we may schedule a short load/burst on Day 2 — 24 hours' advance notice is fine.

DocuSign & SOW: happy to sign the scoped addendum. Please include the 8-hour elevated SLA as an add-on line item.

Forwarding Ben's note for visibility.

Olivia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + access checklist for Oct 18 pen test — mutual action items

All — putting the agreed items in one place (mutual action plan / runway):

1) Access model (provisioned by Oct 14)
   - We will create a timeboxed service account with STS tokens (72-hour default lifetime) and pre-signed S3 push endpoint for NexusGRC pull.
   - IP allowlist: we'll add the CIDR ranges Olivia sends; temporary entries will be labeled "vanguard-pen-2026-10".

2) Elevated SLA (opt-in add-on)
   - 8-hour triage SLA during active test windows if Vanguard selects the add-on in the SOW. Baseline 24 business hour SLA otherwise.

3) Evidence handling and retention
   - Default retention 90 days; artifacts older than 90 days will be auto-deleted unless a retention exception is submitted to security@redwoodinference.com.

4) Escalation & runway
   - Primary infra on-call (infra@redwoodinference.com). Escalation after 4 hours to Ben Carter. Weekend bursts require 24h notice.

5) Security & compliance notes
   - All access is audited in CloudTrail; we will provide signed artifact digests on request.

6) Procurement / docs
   - Ben to send SOW. I'll follow with a DocuSign link for the limited-scope addendum that includes the SLA add-on checkbox.

Next steps: Ben and I will circulate final SOW + DocuSign by EOD tomorrow. Olivia — once you send the CIDR list we'll open the allowlist ticket and provision the temp service account. Suggest a 30-min tech-run sync on Oct 14 to validate connector and token exchange.

Attachments: redwood-temp-creds-expiry-policy.pdf (pdf)

Thanks everyone — I’ll create a short runbook in the NexusGRC integration workspace and add the links to the calendar invite.

Marissa Cole
